instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, medium close-up at eye-level. On a sandy beach, the shirtless man with sunglasses (R2) on the left and the shirtless blonde man (R1) on the right face each other, smiling warmly. They clasp hands in a friendly grip while R1 wraps his arm around R2's shoulder. A yellow volleyball net is blurred in the foreground, and a blurred figure walks in the background under warm natural daylight.
